title: Anterior brain
rights: Original derivative artwork authored for this project; no third-party source.
creator: Oslian
vector_analysis: true vector: 0 <image> elements, no embedded base64 raster
note: Anterior view of the brain: two hemispheres either side of the longitudinal fissure, convoluted gyri with sulci between them, cerebellum below and the brain stem descending. Drawn because no surveyed atlas provides an anterior human brain - the BioArt catalogue has only the lateral view in brain.svg. Authored and serialised to this SVG by the project's own asset tooling, which is not part of this repository; the SVG shipped here is the deliverable.
